claims.claim_vi: The source gives two views of scalability, three bottlenecks (centralized components, high latency components, tight coupling), three principles (statelessness, loose coupling, asynchronous processing) and four techniques (load balancing, caching, event-driven processing, sharding).
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: With 5% serial work, speedup = 1/(0.05 + 0.95/n) gives about 6.9 for n=10, 16.8 for n=100, 19.6 for n=1000 and at most 20.
claims.verified_by: Pure arithmetic on the Amdahl formula, which is the author's general knowledge and not checked against a primary document.

claims.claim_vi: Each technique has a price (stale cache, delayed async results, harder cross-shard queries).
claims.verified_by: General knowledge of the author, not checked against an official document: the writing environment could only reach GitHub, and no official document for this topic is hosted there.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung ghi chú: ba nút thắt và bốn kỹ thuật.
source_deviations: Source lists items; the lesson adds what each bottleneck does and a speedup calculation limited by a serial part.
